Author Pen Name Generator

Generate author pen names with the right vibe for your genre — literary, thriller, romance, fantasy, sci-fi, or children's.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a genre vibe.
  2. Press Generate Pen Names.
  3. Click any name to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which genre vibes are included?

Literary, Thriller, Romance, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, and Children's — each genre has first and last name banks with the right feel.

How many names per click?

8 pen names per click, all unique in the batch.

How do I copy a name?

Click any name to copy it.
